uiMainApp.fame1UC:
Ha a küldetést a 7 forduló előtt befejezed, a következő jutalmakat igényelheted.

A küldetés után, A jutalmak a következőkre használhatók:
uiMainApp.fameItem1UC: • Húzz egy további Tárgy kártyát az általad választott egyik Tárgy pakliból a Lázadó fejlesztés fázisban (költség: 1 Jutalom per kártya).
uiMainApp.fameItem2UC: • Húzz egy további mellékküldetést és tedd játékba mint aktív küldetés (költség: 2 Jutalom per kártya, maximum 2 kártya).
uiMainApp.fame2UC: Amint a forduló számlálója eléri a 8-at, a küldetés jutalma 0 lesz.

Egy hős használhat Medpac-ot, amikor pihenő akciót hajt végre, és egy szövetséges figura használhat Medpac-ot akcióként.

Amikor egy figura Medpac-ot használ, akkor 5 {H} kap vissza. Medpacs megtalálható a ládákban.

uiTacticalAI.docGuard: Guard (hold the zone, never be lured out)
uiTacticalAI.docAmbusher: Ambush (stay unseen until the first shot)
uiTacticalAI.overlordFallback: Taktikai AI – Overlord: a taktikai világadat-csatorna még nem aktív – a tervezés a referenciaszabályok szerint.
uiTacticalAI.specialAsPrinted: Special action: execute exactly as printed on the card.
uiTacticalAI.restLine: Leave this action unperformed: Imperial figures have no Endurance value, so resting would gain them nothing. The figure stays put.
uiTacticalAI.interactLine: Interact: perform an interaction the mission allows (e.g. open an adjacent door, unless the mission has locked it).
uiTacticalAI.focusWounded: he is wounded - finish him first (table damage tracker)
uiTacticalAI.focusFirepower: highest firepower among the remaining heroes (attack dice, then health)
uiTacticalAI.ordAbilitiesLane: Printed special abilities are the Imperium player's call: the attack action may include them exactly as printed (Rules Reference) - the Tactical AI proposes movement and attack only, because deciding 'may' abilities needs the board it never sees.
uiTacticalAI.ordFocusDetail: Focus score: {0} = {1} ({2}); basis: {3}; next: {4} — printed hero-card values, wound marks and the mission goal are the only inputs.
uiTacticalAI.ordPhaseShiftQM: Time runs out: the Imperium leaves its defensive posture and hunts — round {0} of {1} on the mission clock.
uiTacticalAI.ordPhaseExplain: Phase: {0} -> {1} (mission clock in its final third).
uiTacticalAI.apHeadAssault: ACTION POINTS: {0} — OF WHICH ATTACK POINTS: {1} (MULTIPLE ATTACKS PRINTED ON YOUR CARD)
uiTacticalAI.apRule: Read top-down: the first branch answered YES is executed.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeAggressive: ? Attack point available? Focus target within range + clear line of sight? → attack the focus target (weapon/ability range). Line of sight blocked by another hero figure? → attack that blocking figure. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement: move up to {0} spaces toward the focus target. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: focus target still in range? → move into cover with your remaining movement. Focus target NOT in range → move up to {0} spaces toward it.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeGuard: ? Attack point available? Hero in guard zone within range + clear line of sight? → attack. Otherwise check the focus target: attackable? → attack the focus target. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement: up to {0} spaces inside the guard zone toward the nearest hero – or hold position / move into the guard zone. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: up to {0} spaces inside the guard zone toward the nearest hero – or hold position / move into the guard zone.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeBlocker: ? Attack point available? Focus target within range + clear line of sight? → attack the focus target. Line of sight blocked by another hero figure? → attack that blocking figure. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement: up to {0} spaces onto a blocking space between the mission objective and the focus target (no focus target? → toward the nearest hero). ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: hold the blocking space between mission objective and focus target – or shift up to {0} spaces onto one.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeSupport: ? Attack point available? Softest target shootable from cover (range + clear line of sight)? → attack it. No soft target? → attack the focus target if shootable. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement: step back into cover. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: step back into cover.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeAmbush: ? Attack point available? Ambush shot at the first hero you can shoot (range + clear line of sight)? → attack him. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement: up to {0} spaces into new cover. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: relocate to a space no hero can see (up to {0}) – your next shot comes from new cover.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeTripod: Your card's printed rule: movement and shooting exclude each other. ? Attack point available? Nearest hero within reach (range + clear line of sight)? → attack him. No target? → stay on your space. ? Movement strategically necessary? Then: reposition up to {0} spaces – but only if you do NOT want to attack directly afterwards: any movement forbids attacks this round.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeNoTarget: ? Attack point available? Nearest hero within range + clear line of sight? → attack him. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement: move up to {0} spaces toward the nearest hero. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: move up to {0} spaces toward the nearest hero – or move into cover.
uiTacticalAI.apEnd: ◆ ACTION POINT DONE — Points left? → Run the tree again from the top.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeOfficer: Your card's Order: instead of your attack you give movement points to another Imperial figure in reach – you decide at the board. ? Attack point available? Anyone profiting? → Another Imperial figure in reach that ONLY thanks to your movement points could REACH or ATTACK the focus target? → give the Order (movement) – your attack point is spent. No figure profits? → focus target in range + clear line of sight? → attack yourself. Neither Order nor attack possible? → this point becomes movement: move up to {0} spaces toward the focus target (closer to your own figures and the focus target). ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: focus target still in range? → move into cover with your remaining movement. Focus target NOT in range → move up to {0} spaces toward it.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeOfficerElite: Your card's Executive Order (elite ability): instead of your attack, let another Imperial figure in reach attack FOR you – or give it movement points. You decide at the board. ? Attack point available? Order attack: another figure in reach that can attack the focus target FOR you? → it attacks – your attack point becomes its attack. Order movement: another figure in reach that ONLY thanks to your movement points would reach the focus target? → give the Order (movement). No figure profits? → as always yourself: focus target in range + clear line of sight? → attack yourself. Neither Order nor attack possible? → this point becomes movement: move up to {0} spaces toward the focus target. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: focus target still in range? → move into cover with your remaining movement. Focus target NOT in range → move up to {0} spaces toward it.
